card.name: Just before CYP3A inhibitor drug names
card.fires_on: Linking words and punctuation (and, comma, e.g., of, contains) right before a CYP3A or P-gp inhibitor drug is named or described, such as ketoconazole, itraconazole, quinidine or ritonavir.

modes.label: Linker after an inhibitor
modes.description: A comma or 'and' follows an inhibitor drug or phrase, leading into the next inhibitor.

modes.label: Lead-in to examples
modes.description: 'e.g.' or 'of' introduces a list of example inhibitor drugs.

modes.label: Descriptor before inhibitor
modes.description: A word like 'potent' or 'contains' comes just before the word inhibitor or inhibiting components.

card.plain: It fires on small connecting words just before the text names or describes drugs that block CYP3A liver enzymes.
